title: 第5章 是法平等无有高下6k7第6章 内气生由定生慧

“伤身殒命……”
鱼吞舟自语。
就在刚才，谢临川为鱼吞舟介绍了这门【星火诀】的由来。
来头听上去就极大，竟然是上古人皇为人族所创！
只是后世修行法历经千锤百炼，相较上古有多处增进，所以这门服气法放在当世，只能勉强排入上乘。
此外，就是太过霸烈而伤身。
听了谢临川的介绍，鱼吞舟心如明镜，那姓陈的将【星火诀】交易给自己，八成是不怀好心。
“族中记载，这门【星火诀】乃是人皇根据上古时期的人族体质所创，非当今人族能适应。”
“放到今世，如果不是上古人皇之名，这门服气法早就被划入了魔道速成的行列。”
谢临川纸扇一合，若有所思道：“这门服气法失传许久，世间只剩残本，没想到北陈皇室手中竟然有完整的法门……”
鱼吞舟感谢道：“这趟多谢谢兄帮忙了！”
如果不是谢临川突然出现，主动配合当托，陈玄业就算会与他交易，也绝不会这般冤大头，拿出上乘级数的服气诀。
想到这，鱼吞舟笑容愈发灿烂。
对他来说，这已经是莫大惊喜了。
谢临川见鱼吞舟丝毫没被伤身殒命吓到，不由挑眉道：“你就一点不怕？”
“不是不怕，只是不练就死，这笔账很好算。”
鱼吞舟解释道。
谢临川默然收扇，总觉得面前少年说话间，透着一股通透。
“不用谢我，是师叔祖让我来助你一臂之力，还你额外的龙鱼之情。”

谢临川话锋一转，目光落在鱼吞舟身上，目光罕见多了几分复杂，
“这【星火诀】的确霸烈伤身，我也能猜到那陈玄业究竟打着什么算盘，只是他算漏了一件事！”
“星火诀再是霸烈伤身，可你既然有福缘吃上三年龙鱼，体质也非常人能比，扛过去应当不成问题。”
鱼吞舟眼睛一亮，原来如此，难怪方才谢临川暗示他见好就收。
那这门【星火诀】的确是最适合他当下处境的功法了。
真要是没有副作用的上乘法诀，对方恐怕也舍不得掏出来与他交易。
他与谢临川询问了这枚玉佩的使用方式，然后又请教了静心入定的标准。
“你还真准备靠自己入定？”
谢临川目光奇异，转瞬又摇头道，
“不过也是，你能换到服气法，却绝然换不到观想图，要想入定，只能靠自己。”
见鱼吞舟不解，他便解释道：
“观想图涉及的是元神修行，是各家修行之秘，与核心神功并列，其重要程度不是服气法能比拟的。”
他还有句话没说，怕打击鱼吞舟积极性。
哪怕鱼吞舟修成了【星火诀】，并靠自己入定，日后服气的效率，也比不上以观想图铸就了元神内相的小镇同龄人。
谢临川问道：“你现在龙鱼也卖了出去，不上山好好揣摩这门【星火诀】？”
鱼吞舟道：“三年都等过来了，不急于这一时。
我答应了一位长者，要去镇里帮忙清扫一间老宅。”
“清扫老宅？”
谢临川诧异道，“哪家？”
“镇上最北边那家。”

"Injury to body and death..."
The fish swallows the boat and talks to itself.
Just now, Xie Linchuan introduced the origin of this [Spark Technique] to Yu Tunzhou.
The background sounds huge, it was actually created by the ancient human emperor for the human race!
It's just that the practice methods of later generations have gone through many hardships and have improved in many ways compared to ancient times. Therefore, this method of subduing qi can only be ranked among the best in today's world.
In addition, it is too domineering and harmful to the body.
After listening to Xie Linchuan's introduction, Yu Tunzhou felt as if he had a clear mind. The man named Chen probably had bad intentions when he traded the [Star Fire Technique] to him.
"It is recorded in the clan that this [Star Fire Technique] was created by the Human Emperor based on the physique of the human race in ancient times. It is not something that today's human race can adapt to."
"In today's world, if it weren't for the name of the ancient human emperor, this Qi Convincing Technique would have been classified as a quick way to achieve magic."
Xie Linchuan closed the paper fan and said thoughtfully: "This method of subduing qi has been lost for a long time, and there are only fragments left in the world. I didn't expect that the Beichen royal family actually has a complete method in their hands..."
Yu Tunzhou thanked him: "Thank you so much for your help on this trip!"
If Xie Linchuan hadn't suddenly appeared and actively cooperated with him, even if Chen Xuanye would have traded with him, he would never have taken advantage of him and used the superior Qi Convincing Technique.
Thinking of this, Yu Tunzhou's smile became even brighter.
For him, this was already a great surprise.
When Xie Linchuan saw that Yu Tunzhou was not at all frightened by his injuries or death, he couldn't help but raise his eyebrows and said, "Aren't you afraid at all?"
"It's not that I'm not afraid, it's just that if I don't practice, I will die. This is an easy calculation."
Yutunzhou explained.
Xie Linchuan closed his fan silently, always feeling that there was a sense of transparency in the words of the young man in front of him.
"You don't need to thank me. It's my uncle who asked me to help you and give you the extra kindness."
Xie Linchuan changed the topic and his eyes fell on Yu Tunzhou. His eyes were a little more complicated than usual.
"This [Star Fire Technique] is indeed powerful and harmful to the body. I can also guess what Chen Xuanye was planning, but he missed one thing!"
"The Star Fire Technique will hurt your body no matter how powerful it is, but since you have been lucky enough to eat arowana for three years, and your physique is incomparable to other people, it shouldn't be a problem to survive it."
Yu Tunzhou's eyes lit up. That's it. No wonder Xie Linchuan just hinted that he would give up as soon as possible.
Then this [Star Fire Technique] is indeed the most suitable technique for his current situation.
If there were really a superior magic technique with no side effects, the other party might not be willing to take it out and trade with him.
He and Xie Linchuan asked about how to use this jade pendant, and then asked about the standards for meditating and entering concentration.
"Are you really prepared to enter samadhi on your own?"
Xie Linchuan's eyes were strange, and he shook his head and said,
"But yes, you can change to the Qi Convincing Method, but you can never change to the visualization diagram. If you want to enter samadhi, you can only rely on yourself."
Seeing that the fish swallowed the boat, he explained:
"The visualization diagram involves the cultivation of the soul, which is the secret of each practice. It is parallel to the core magical skills. Its importance cannot be compared with that of the Qi Convincing Method."
He didn't say anything for fear of dampening Yu Tunzhou's enthusiasm.
Even if Yu Tunzhou had mastered the [Spark Technique] and entered samadhi on his own, his efficiency in being convinced in the future would still be inferior to that of his peers in the small town who had used visualization diagrams to create the inner aspect of their souls.
Xie Linchuan asked: "Now that you have sold the dragon fish, why don't you go up the mountain to study the [Spark Technique]?"
Yu Tunzhou said: "I have been waiting for three years, so I am not in a hurry for this moment.
I promised an elder that I would go to the town to help clean an old house. "
"Cleaning the old house?"
Xie Linchuan asked in surprise, "Which one?"
"The northernmost one in town."
